macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Weak U.S. jobs report boosts stocks and reduces October Fed hike bets
items.summary: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September, well below the 90,000 forecast, while unemployment rose to 4.2%. The data lowered expectations for an October Federal Reserve rate hike and helped lift stocks.[1]

items.title: Major U.S. indexes rally after payrolls data
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.49% to 51,176.96, the S&P 500 gained 0.73% to 7,722.72, and the Nasdaq advanced 1.19% to 27,190.86. Nvidia gained 1.3% and Tesla climbed 4.7%.[1]

items.title: Nike shares fall on weak outlook and restructuring
items.summary: Nike dropped 3.6% after forecasting a sharp annual revenue decline tied partly to weakness in China. The company also announced job cuts and changes to its global business divisions.[1]

items.title: Long-term Treasury yields remain elevated
items.summary: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield was reported near 5.28%, reflecting continued pressure in longer-dated bonds despite softer labor-market data.[2]

items.title: Toshiba plans to expand AI-data-center hard-drive production
items.summary: Toshiba plans to double production capacity for hard disk drives used in AI data centers by fiscal 2027, according to Nikkei reporting cited in market coverage.[1]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: SEC clears listings for six 3x leveraged crypto ETPs
items.summary: The SEC approved a Cboe BZX rule change allowing Volatility Shares to list triple-leveraged Bitcoin and Ether futures ETPs, though registration requirements remain and trading has not necessarily begun.[1]

items.title: Bitcoin holds near $85,000 as major tokens post modest gains
items.summary: Bitcoin traded around $84,860.50 and was little changed over 24 hours. Ether rose 0.65% to about $2,694.78, Solana gained 0.98%, and BNB advanced 2.51%, while Cardano and Dogecoin declined.[1]

items.title: TRUMP meme token surges more than 112%
items.summary: The TRUMP meme coin recorded a reported 112.2% gain in the latest market snapshot, substantially outperforming major cryptocurrencies during the period.[1]

items.title: Japan adds Garantex to Russia sanctions list
items.summary: Japan reportedly added cryptocurrency exchange Garantex to its sanctions list related to the war in Ukraine, with separate coverage indicating that the move freezes the exchange’s assets.[3]

items.title: EU examines Binance reverse-solicitation practices
items.summary: EU regulators are reportedly examining whether Binance used reverse solicitation to serve customers without a MiCA license, adding to regulatory scrutiny of the exchange.[3]

items.title: XRP Asia launches with Ripple and XRPL Foundation backing
items.summary: XRP Asia launched with support from Ripple and the XRP Ledger Foundation to promote XRPL adoption across the Asia-Pacific region.[8]

items.title: PUBG: Black Budget development canceled
items.summary: Krafton reportedly canceled development of the planned PUBG extraction shooter PUBG: Black Budget, marking the second canceled PUBG project this year.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day sets series record in early access
items.summary: Gears of War: E-Day reportedly achieved a franchise record during early access, while related coverage also highlighted controversy surrounding the game’s collaboration with outside groups.

items.title: Sony reportedly accepting pitches for PlayStation revivals
items.summary: Sony is reportedly considering pitches for returning PlayStation franchises, though no specific revival has been officially confirmed and details remain speculative.

items.title: EA Sports FC 27 launches worldwide
items.summary: EA Sports FC 27 officially launched worldwide as part of the week’s major game releases.

items.title: Sony announces AI upscaling for base PS5
items.summary: Sony announced plans to bring AI-powered upscaling technology to the standard PlayStation 5, extending a feature previously associated with the PS5 Pro.

items.title: Bungie co-founder unveils Stone Kite Studios
items.summary: Bungie co-founder Alex Seropian revealed a new development company, Stone Kite Studios, adding another new independent studio to the games industry.
